gettingThere.tip: Tokaido Shinkansen bullet train from Tokyo Station directly to Kyoto Station.
Overnight highway bus saves one night of hotel stay.
Fly to Osaka Itami (ITM), then 45-minute airport limousine bus into Kyoto.

days.title: Arrival & Historic Higashiyama
days.notes: Arrive before noon to beat temple crowds on Sannenzaka slope.

activities.name: Check-in & Matcha Ceremony at Camellia
activities.description: Authentic tea ritual near Kiyomizu-dera led by a certified tea master.
activities.note: Book slot in advance. Remove shoes at the genkan.

activities.name: Kiyomizu-dera Wooden Stage
activities.description: UNESCO World Heritage cliffside Buddhist temple offering panoramic views of ancient Kyoto.
activities.note: Drink from Otowa Waterfall fountains for health and longevity.

activities.name: Sunset Stroll & Dining along Gion Shirakawa
activities.description: Lantern-lit canal walk lined with willow trees, traditional machiya houses, and kaiseki restaurants.

days.title: Spiritual Torii Gates & Sake District
days.notes: Early morning start recommended for Fushimi Inari summit hike.

activities.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha 10,000 Vermilion Gates
activities.description: Hike through winding corridors of bright vermilion torii gates winding up Mount Inari.
activities.note: Midway crossroads (Yotsutsuji) has great city panoramas.

activities.name: Gekkeikan Okura Sake Museum & Tasting
activities.description: Century-old timber brewery exploring historical brewing techniques and tasting local Fushimi water sakes.

activities.name: Pontocho Alley Dining Experience
activities.description: Atmospheric dining lane beside the Kamogawa River with riverside wooden terraces (Kawayuka).

days.title: Zen Bamboo Groves & Golden Pavilion
days.notes: Rent bicycles at Arashiyama Station for the morning bamboo ride.

activities.name: Sagano Bamboo Forest & Tenryu-ji Zen Garden
activities.description: Walk among towering stalks of green bamboo whispering in the mountain breeze.

activities.name: Okochi Sanso Villa & Hilltop Garden
activities.description: Quiet estate with sweeping vistas of Hozu Gorge and serene moss gardens.

activities.name: Kinkaku-ji (The Golden Pavilion)
activities.description: Iconic Zen temple completely covered in gold leaf reflecting over mirror-flat Kyoko-chi pond.
activities.note: Closes strictly at 5:00 PM. Best lighting during late golden hour.

days.title: Kitchen of Kyoto & Philosopher's Path
days.notes: Bring cash for Nishiki Market vendors.

activities.name: Nishiki Market Street Food Odyssey
activities.description: Five-block narrow shopping arcade bustling with over one hundred seafood, pickle, and wagashi stalls.
activities.note: Try the soy milk donuts, tako tamago (baby octopus), and seasonal yuzu dango.

activities.name: Ginkaku-ji (Silver Pavilion) & Sand Garden
activities.description: Refined temple complex featuring the famous Sea of Silver Sand dry garden and elevated forest trail.

activities.name: Philosopher's Path Cherry Blossom Walk
activities.description: Stone path following a tree-lined canal, named after Kyoto University philosopher Nishida Kitaro.

days.title: Zen Rock Gardens & Departure
days.notes: Leave luggage at Kyoto Station lockers before morning tour.

activities.name: Ryoan-ji Temple Karesansui Rock Garden
activities.description: World-renowned dry landscape garden with fifteen mystical moss-bordered boulders nestled in raked white gravel.

activities.name: Souvenir Shopping & Matcha Parfait at Kyoto Station Skyway
activities.description: Browse regional crafts and sample Uji matcha dessert overlooking the station’s futuristic glass atrium.

activities.name: Shinkansen Departure to Tokyo
activities.description: Board high-speed bullet train for a scenic glide past Mount Fuji back to Tokyo.
